paper_title: Search for Dark Matter Axions with CAST-CAPP
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1 as plotted on y-axis
notes: CAST-CAPP haloscope search at CERN (4124 h, 2019-2021), scanning 4.774-5.434 GHz (19.74-22.47 ueV). Paper reports exclusion of axion-photon couplings for virialized galactic axions down to g_agamma = 8e-14 GeV^-1 at 90% CL. The actual exclusion curve (Fig. 5) varies with mass and is deepest near ~22 ueV where phase-matching was predominantly used; no numerical table is provided, so the two data points encode the best quoted limit across the stated mass range as a flat approximation. Assumes local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and standard Maxwell-Boltzmann virialized halo lineshape (~7 kHz lab-frame linewidth).
